upload_id.meaning: Upload session identifier from the HTTP path.

index.meaning: Chunk index from the HTTP path; its product with chunk size must equal bytes already received.

body.meaning: Raw chunk bytes, not JSON; bounded by the smaller of remaining bytes and session chunk size. A nonfinal chunk must fill that bound.

content-type.meaning: HTTP header whose trimmed media type before any semicolon must be application/octet-stream.

x-caduceus-document.meaning: HTTP header matching the document bound to the session.

x-caduceus-attendance.meaning: HTTP attendance header, required for a session started on attendance basis.

bytes_received.meaning: Cumulative byte count after a successful chunk.

ok.meaning: False on an explicit handler refusal; the success body contains bytes_received.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists the fixed literal handler refusals. The handler supplies no open-form signals; its success body does not supply this field.
